holes.notes: Physical image scale from the Leica LAS scale bar burnt into every image (verified on BP 1-30): DAB 957.1 um / 370 px = 2.5868 um/px, Neck 954.5 um / 369 px = 2.5867 um/px; Holes '3.7 mm' = 1435-1440 px and Mixing '6.4 mm' = 2473-2481 px (labels rounded to 0.1 mm) agree. One physical scale for all image types. Replaces the 2.5 um/px value that came from entering the drawing nominal (0.5 mm) for a clicked hole. To verify: py calibrate.py verify on the scale bar (click its two ends; known length = scale_bar_label_mm). Confirm against a certified stage micrometer when available.

neck.notes: PRODUCTION neck scale kept at the legacy 2.66667 um/px (from entering the 0.20 mm drawing nominal for a clicked neck) so the provisional LEGACY neck measurement stays comparable to the previously validated production results. The physically observed image scale (Leica scale bar, 2.587 um/px, same as holes/DAB/mixing) is recorded under observed_image_scale and is NOT used for the legacy measurement. The CH05 neck definition is unresolved -- see docs/MEASUREMENT_ACCURACY_VALIDATION.md.

observed_image_scale.source: Leica scale bar in Neck_ch00.png: 954.5 um / 369 px = 2.5867 um/px (BP 24/25/30: 957.1 um / 370 px = 2.5868)
